resolvedQuestions.text: What file formats, schema generations, and canonical daily-data semantics does the plugin accept?
How do folder discovery, file patterns, format selection, caching, and compatibility scanning behave?
What is the complete health-viz block contract, including date variables, appearance, and validation?
How are roll-ups, the data dictionary, lossless archives, granular tables, and large files handled without double counting or unsafe ingestion?
Which Apple/Android export differences and file-layer edge cases constrain reliable automation?

keyFindings.label: Current plugin release 2.1.0 accepts JSON CSV Markdown frontmatter and Bases daily data
Mixed daily schemas v0 through v7 are supported and newer versions are best effort
Data folder structure glob format cache invalidation and compatibility scan are separate controls
The render fence is health-viz with type required and from to last as common date controls
An empty default Health folder activates deterministic bundled mock data
Daily summaries rollups dictionary metadata and lossless source archives are distinct ingest layers
The plugin excludes canonical records routes waveforms clinical payloads and binary data from day cache metrics
Apple v7 Android frozen v4 and Android analytical v5 are independent compatibility profiles
Platform permission and export-selection gaps must not be normalized to zero
Android raw snapshots are archival products and not daily HealthData inputs
Existing packet examples use the wrong fence and invented chart keys
Existing packet verification omits the mock fallback and real-source assertion
